channel.title: JPHsystems — field notes
channel.description: Specific problems, with the fix attached: network segmentation, security remediation and small internal tools.

item.title: Ship the internal tool
item.dc:creator: JPHsystems
item.description: The spreadsheet that runs an operation is already software — it just has no tests, no audit trail and one owner. How to scope and ship the small replacement.

item.title: Your pentest report is not a remediation plan
item.dc:creator: JPHsystems
item.description: A pentest produces evidence, not a plan. What to ask for before the engagement, and how to turn findings into work with owners, sequence and proof.

item.title: The flat network is still the default
item.dc:creator: JPHsystems
item.description: One VLAN, one subnet and a VPN that lands you inside it. Why flat networks persist, and the segmentation order that actually gets finished.
